# Nuvio With Live TV Issue Guidelines

Nuvio With Live TV is a fork of Nuvio focused on adding and improving
Live TV functionality.

## What belongs here?

Issues should be specifically related to:

- Live TV
- IPTV
- M3U playlists
- Xtream Codes
- XMLTV / EPG
- Channel management
- Channel groups
- Favorites
- Recently watched channels
- Catch-up TV
- Live TV playback
- Live TV search
- Live TV UI / UX
- Live TV integration with the Nuvio experience

## What does NOT belong here?

Please do not submit requests or bugs for functionality unrelated
to Live TV, including the original Nuvio movie and TV experience.

## Before submitting

Please search existing issues first. Duplicate requests make it
harder to track development.

Feature requests are suggestions and are not guarantees of future
implementation.
